_doc: Parts fix engine parity fixtures (handoff/fixtures/parts_fixes.py on parts_proto.py v15, catalog fixes.json -> parts). For each case, suggestPartsFixes(reading, {occasion, styles: the case's styles, else profile, boldness, secondLook, closet, warm, firstCheck}) must equal `expected` after mapping camelCase to these keys, exactly. closet 'seed' = `closet` here, 'empty' = []. A case's reading is readings[id] here, else rubric_parity.json's readings[id]. expected.fixes[i] and expected.smaller_step are indices into `pool`.
